mappings.notes: Team model + settings routes.
Invitation model + invite routes.
ApiKey (boxyhq) and ApiKeys (nextcrm) models.
Svix-backed team webhook routes.
Jackson SAML integration.
Jackson dsync + SCIM v2.0 routes.
Retraced integration.
Stripe Subscription/Price models + webhook handler.
Stripe subscription status enum includes 'trialing'; no dedicated trial UI/logic found.
No onboarding wizard or first-run setup step found in boxyhq-saas-starter (checked pages/, components/onboarding not present); new teams land directly on the dashboard.

Service (features: String[]) + Price + Subscription models define plan tiers and the active subscription per team; no feature-gating or usage/seat-limit enforcement logic found (models/subscription.ts only syncs Stripe status).

No usage-event model or metering code in boxyhq-saas-starter; Lago (billing API) has the relevant BillableMetric/Event/DailyUsage models but is not cloned on disk (sources/MANIFEST.json has no local_path for it), so no citable path exists.

No staff-only cross-tenant console or impersonation route found in boxyhq-saas-starter (grepped for impersonat/super-admin/platform-admin); delete-team.js is an operator CLI script, not an admin console UI.

Cachet models the public status/incident page shape but is not cloned on disk (sources/MANIFEST.json has no local_path for it), so no citable path exists; nothing in boxyhq-saas-starter or nextcrm implements a status page.
No changelog/release-notes model or feed found in either cloned repo.
No tenant-wide data export/backup job in boxyhq-saas-starter; nextcrm's actions/reports/export-csv.ts only serializes report chart data points, not a tenant data export.

Unleash has the relevant FeatureToggle/IFeatureStrategy model but is not cloned on disk (sources/MANIFEST.json has no local_path for it), so no citable path exists; no flag system found in boxyhq-saas-starter or nextcrm.
TeamMember (boxyhq-saas-starter prisma/schema.prisma) has no seat count, seat limit, or pending-vs-active seat field; Subscription has no quantity field either.
boxyhq-saas-starter's Role is a fixed enum (ADMIN/OWNER/MEMBER) with a hardcoded permission map (lib/permissions.ts); no per-workspace role/permission authoring found.
models/team.ts deleteTeam() is a plain prisma.team.delete (hard delete, no soft-delete field, no export offer, no grace period).

No rate limiting in boxyhq-saas-starter (checked by grep); nextcrm's lib/enrichment/rate-limit.ts is a per-IP Upstash limiter for one outbound enrichment endpoint, not per-key/per-plan limiting on the platform's own public API.
No test-mode workspace or synthetic-data sandbox found in either cloned repo (nextcrm's e2b references are a code-execution sandbox for AI enrichment, unrelated to this feature).
No region-pinning or data-residency control found in either cloned repo.
